points: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you. Read it again: for they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you.
And how ye turned to God from idols. And how ye turned to God from idols.
To serve the living and true God; and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
